posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Odin:

Interesting observation but somewhere on the forums I believe it was stated that sotm does not involve the Norse mythos

Be careful how you word that, its a bit out of context.

There is no litteral manifestation of Norse Mythology is what I believe was ment. When I first delved into the Norse mythos connection, everyone took it quite litterally and thought I was implying that the "Cosmic Entity" was Odin proper. That was never going to be the case in my mind, but it was clarified anyway. If I recall correctly, Christopher was an english major. Those sneaky devils  never do things litterally. Its all allusions, misdirections, and entendre's with them.  Matriarch does not weild the power of Odin's very own birds. But they weren't names exactly chosen at random either. 

Sure I run the risk of diving into a pool thats a few inches deep, but such is the danger of deconstructing any work of art. But you understand that at some point to some degree, all art, from narratives to pictures to music ect, is derivitive of those before it. Transformed maybe, but derivitive none the less. Knowing that allows us to find threads that connect generations together, trace influences, and help shape the personal meaning we take away from art that inspires us.

I need a nap.
